articles.title: Blockchain.com targets $500 million IPO this year at up to $6 billion valuation
articles.snippet: The London-based crypto services company confidentially filed for an initial public offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission earlier this year.

articles.title: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security
articles.snippet: The new software lets companies add custom security checks so they do not fall victim to the same type of vulnerabilities that plagued rival bridges.

articles.title: Nvidia unveils AI safety platform to rein in ‘rogue’ AI agents
articles.snippet: The launch comes after several AI agents breached their testing environments this year, adding to calls for companies to slow the development of autonomous AI systems.

articles.title: Blockchain.com eyes $500M IPO as crypto capital markets thaw: Report
articles.snippet: The crypto company is seeking a valuation of up to $6 billion, well below its 2022 peak, as recently listed crypto stocks struggle to hold their gains.

articles.title: Anthropic Lost $42 Billion Last Year. It Wants to Go Public at $2 Trillion
articles.snippet: The company's IPO prospectus shows revenue up twelvefold, a $518 billion spending plan, and a risk section warning that its own AI could pose existential risks to humanity.
